decisions.claim: B is having a meal at the restaurant
decisions.reason: The phrase 'before your meal' in turn 3 directly presupposes that B will have a meal at the restaurant. This is a clear definite possessive presupposition.
The definite possessive 'your drink' in turn 7 presupposes that a drink has been ordered for B. This is a direct factual presupposition.
The definite possessive 'your salad' in turn 7 presupposes that a salad has been ordered for B. This is a direct factual presupposition.

decisions.claim: B is dining at a restaurant in the evening
decisions.reason: Turn 1 explicitly states 'I'll be your waiter this evening,' establishing both the restaurant context (waiter role) and the time (evening). B is being served by a waiter, confirming B is dining at a restaurant in the evening.

decisions.claim: B has ordered a meal (main course)
decisions.reason: The phrase 'before your meal' in turn 3 presupposes B will have a main course (the 'meal' distinct from appetizers). However, 'has ordered' is slightly stronger than the presupposition warrants since turn 1 shows ordering may not yet be complete. Still, the definite possessive 'your meal' strongly implies B has committed to a main course. Grounded as E2 inference.
decisions.counterexample: B might have said 'I'll have the steak' but not yet formally placed the order with the kitchen; however the definite 'your meal' makes this unlikely.
